1.description: A creator-portfolio concept built around a bold hero, entrance choreography, magnetic hover and an image marquee.

features.title: Entrance choreography
features.detail: The hero composes staggered FadeIn elements for the heading, navigation, portrait and contact action.

features.title: Pointer-responsive portrait
features.detail: The portrait is wrapped by the Magnet component; review how pointer movement is translated into a visual response.

features.title: Scroll-driven marquee
features.detail: Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform drive the horizontal image-row offsets.

1.caveat: The portrait and marquee GIFs are loaded from third-party domains. Availability and reuse rights must be checked independently.

3.description: An editorial creative-studio landing page combining a video-backed hero, animated typography and scroll-revealed feature cards.

features.title: Animated typography
features.detail: WordsPullUp reveals the oversized headline using a dedicated text animation component.

features.title: Sequenced hero content
features.detail: Framer Motion coordinates entrance transitions for the introduction and call to action.

features.title: Scroll-triggered features
features.detail: The feature cards use useInView to animate as they appear in the viewport.

3.caveat: Hero video and some feature assets reference remote services. Button destinations are conceptual, not production business workflows.

20.description: A motion experiment featuring a video-to-canvas boomerang playback effect and a GSAP-assisted mouse-follow parallax layer.

features.title: Capture and replay frames
features.detail: The source captures video frames into canvas buffers, then alternates playback direction on a display canvas.

features.title: Pointer-tracked parallax
features.detail: Pointer movement triggers short GSAP tweens, avoiding a continuously running idle requestAnimationFrame loop.

features.title: Consider memory and motion settings
features.detail: Capture now samples at up to eight frames per second, with a 480px maximum width and 48-frame cap. The demo skips video capture under reduced-motion and provides a static fallback when remote media fails.

20.caveat: The demo still depends on an external video URL; Canvas memory is bounded but needs device-specific testing and permission checks.

22.description: A travel-themed hero composition using a full-screen video, glass-like navigation and smooth GSAP pointer parallax.

features.title: Layered cinematic hero
features.detail: A looping background video sits behind a dark overlay and foreground text.

features.title: Smooth mouse parallax
features.detail: Fine-pointer movement triggers short GSAP tweens on the video wrapper, rather than running a permanent requestAnimationFrame loop.

features.title: Timed entrance states
features.detail: Entrance transitions create the staged hero reveal. The browser's reduced-motion setting now prevents decorative video loading and pointer parallax.

22.caveat: The background video is hosted externally. This is a visual travel concept; there is no booking service, and the source link is the active call to action.

28.description: A digital-brand landing page with Motion-based hero entrances, a floating glass navigation element and a continuous logo marquee.

features.title: Motion hero reveal
features.detail: The lead content animates its opacity and vertical position via motion.div.

features.title: Floating navigation
features.detail: The page uses a positioned translucent motion.nav with its own entrance sequence.

features.title: Marquee construction
features.detail: The logo row duplicates data and uses CSS animation; the carousel is paused for visitors requesting reduced motion.

28.caveat: External video is skipped for reduced-motion visitors, but the normal demo still relies on remote media and third-party logos as design references. No endorsement is implied.
